SELECT hbm.bp_name, hbm.extra_nam FROM hls_bp_master hbm, lon_credit_contract lcc
lcc.credit_bp_id=hbm.bp_id
AND hbm.bp_name LIKE concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%') )
AND hbm.bp_id = ( SELECT credit_bp_id FROM lon_credit_contract WHERE CREDIT_CON_NUMBER = ( SELECT MAX(CREDIT_CON_NUMBER) FROM lon_credit_contract c WHERE c.business_type='LON_CREDIT_CONTRACT' AND c.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND c.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' ))

SELECT hbm.bp_name, hbm.extra_nam FROM hls_bp_master hbm, lon_credit_contract lcc
lcc.credit_bp_id=hbm.bp_id
AND hbm.extra_nam LIKE concat('%',concat(#{extraNam},'%') ) AND lcc.company_id = #{request.companyId}
AND hbm.bp_id = ( SELECT credit_bp_id FROM lon_credit_contract WHERE LAST_UPDATE_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE) FROM lon_credit_contract c WHERE c.business_type='LON_CREDIT_CONTRACT' AND c.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND c.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND c.company_id = #{request.companyId}))

lcc.credit_category = 'EXPOSURE_CREDIT' and lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' ) -( SELECT nvl(sum(lc.finance_amount) , 0) FROM lon_contract lc , lon_credit_contract lcc WHERE lc.credit_contract_id = lcc.credit_contract_id AND lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.credit_category = 'EXPOSURE_CREDIT' AND lc.contract_status = 'APPROVED' and lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' )) exposure_rest_amt , sum(( SELECT nvl(sum(lc.finance_amount) , 0) FROM lon_contract lc , lon_credit_contract lcc WHERE lc.credit_contract_id = lcc.credit_contract_id AND lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.credit_category = 'EXPOSURE_CREDIT' AND lc.contract_status = 'APPROVED' and lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' lcc.credit_line_id = hclt.credit_line_id and lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.credit_category = 'LOW_RISK_CREDIT' and lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' ) -( SELECT nvl(sum(lc.finance_amount) , 0) FROM lon_contract lc , lon_credit_contract lcc WHERE lc.credit_contract_id = lcc.credit_contract_id AND lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.credit_category = 'LOW_RISK_CREDIT' AND lc.contract_status = 'APPROVED' and lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lc.data_class = 'NORMAL' and lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' )) low_risk_rest_amt , sum(( SELECT nvl(sum(lc.finance_amount),0) FROM lon_contract lc , lon_credit_contract lcc WHERE lc.credit_contract_id = lcc.credit_contract_id AND lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND hcl.bp_id = hbm.bp_id

AND hbm.bp_name LIKE concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%') )
AND hcl.bp_id= (SELECT bp_id FROM hls_credit_line WHERE LAST_UPDATE_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE) FROM hls_credit_line WHERE business_type='FINANCING_LOAN' ))

SELECT lcc.credit_line_id, lcc.document_category, lcc.document_type, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lcc.credit_bp_id) as bp_name, hcl.credit_line_amt, nvl(hcl.credit_exposure_amt,0) as credit_exposure_amt, (case lcc.credit_category when 'EXPOSURE_CREDIT' then '敞口额度' when 'LOW_RISK_CREDIT' then '低风险额度' else '未知类型' end) as credit_category, hcl.valid_to, hcl.company_id, hcl.proposer_employee_assign_id, (select fe.employee_code from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hcl.proposer_employee_id) as employee_code FROM lon_credit_contract lcc, hls_credit_line hcl WHERE lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' and ((hcl.valid_to = to_char(date_add(sysdate, interval 1 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (hcl.valid_to = to_char(date_add(sysdate, interval 2 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (hcl.valid_to = to_char(date_add(sysdate, interval 3 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) )

SELECT lcc.credit_line_id, lcc.document_category, lcc.document_type, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lcc.credit_bp_id) as bp_name, hcl.credit_line_amt, nvl(hcl.credit_exposure_amt,0) as credit_exposure_amt, (case lcc.credit_category when 'EXPOSURE_CREDIT' then '敞口额度' when 'LOW_RISK_CREDIT' then '低风险额度' else '未知类型' end) as credit_category, hcl.delay_to, hcl.company_id, hcl.proposer_employee_assign_id, (select fe.employee_code from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hcl.proposer_employee_id) as employee_code FROM lon_credit_contract lcc, hls_credit_line hcl WHERE lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' and ((hcl.delay_to = to_chardate_add(sysdate, interval 1 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (hcl.delay_to = to_chardate_add(sysdate, interval 2 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (hcl.delay_to = to_chardate_add(sysdate, interval 3 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) )

SELECT lcc.credit_line_id, lcc.document_category, lcc.document_type, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = lcc.credit_bp_id) as bp_name, hcl.credit_line_amt, nvl(hcl.credit_exposure_amt,0) as credit_exposure_amt, (case lcc.credit_category when 'EXPOSURE_CREDIT' then '敞口额度' when 'LOW_RISK_CREDIT' then '低风险额度' else '未知类型' end) as credit_category, hcl.first_withdraw_date, hcl.company_id, hcl.proposer_employee_assign_id, (select fe.employee_code from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hcl.proposer_employee_id) as employee_code FROM lon_credit_contract lcc, hls_credit_line hcl WHERE lcc.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id AND lcc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND lcc.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' and ( (hcl.first_withdraw_date = to_char(date_add(sysdate, interval 1 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (hcl.first_withdraw_date = to_char(date_add(sysdate, interval 2 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) or (hcl.first_withdraw_date = to_char(date_add(sysdate, interval 3 month),'YYYY-MM-DD')) )
